Requisition ID:  3541

Deputy Executive Manager, Finance

Job Summary

The job holder is responsible in driving financial analysis, planning, and control across various strategic projects within the Club including managing financial processes, enhancing governance controls, and ensuring compliance with financial policies. The primary purpose is to provide robust financial oversight and support to ensure effective budgeting, forecasting, and governance for major initiatives, including infrastructure projects and operational strategies. This job holder serves as a trusted business partner, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across the Club to facilitate informed decision-making through detailed financial insights and analysis.

The Job

  • Provide comprehensive financial control, planning, budgeting, and forecasting support for various strategic projects and initiatives across departments.
  • Collaborate closely with project sponsors, budget holders, and business managers to prepare annual budgets, monitor project costs, and ensure compliance with governance and financial policies.
  • Conduct in-depth financial analysis to identify key business drivers, support the financial planning process, and facilitate effective management discussions.
  • Oversee the implementation of budgetary controls, prepare timely management reports, and track financial performance against budgets.
  • Support capital investment evaluations by analyzing financial proposals to ensure alignment with organizational strategy, risk mitigation, and proper governance.
  • Facilitate collaboration and communication between finance teams and various stakeholders to enhance financial processes, reporting, and decision-making.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives in financial processes, aiming for efficiency, standardization, and automation.
  • Provide training and mentorship to finance team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, effective communication, and professional development.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, corporate governance requirements, and financial policies throughout financial operations and project management.
  • Analyze financial performance data to identify cost-saving opportunities and enhance resource allocation strategies across departments.
  • Act as a business partner, providing strategic financial insights to support divisional and club-wide initiatives and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on KPIs to facilitate effective decision-making and drive successful project outcomes.

About You

  • Bachelor degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline is required.
  • Relevant professional qualifications such as CPA, CA, or equivalent are essential.
  • At least 10 years of professional experience in finance or accounting, with a focus on financial planning, analysis, and management.
  • A minimum of 3-5 years in a managerial or supervisory role is required.
  • Experience in managing large-scale projects or operations is preferred, with an understanding of core project management principles.
  • Solid experience in financial analysis, corporate planning, financial modelling, and management control is necessary.
